headline.title: Gemini 4 Argon 登上 Google 官方博客，成为 Hacker News 当日最热帖
headline.summary: Hacker News 上指向 Google 官方博客的链接“Gemini 4 Argon”成为当日最热帖，获得约 1215 分和 785 条评论。社区同时提到一篇围绕该模型智能、性能与价格的分析帖。该条目本身未提供更多官方细节，但热度显示外界对新一代 Gemini 模型的关注度极高。
headline.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon Lands on Google's Blog, Tops Hacker News
headline.summary_en: A link to Google's official blog titled "Gemini 4 Argon" became the day's top item on Hacker News, drawing roughly 1,215 points and 785 comments. A companion thread points to a separate analysis of the model's intelligence, performance and pricing. The item itself carries few official details, but the reaction signals intense interest in the next Gemini release.
headline.reason: 模型发布类消息通常影响面最广；该条目在 Hacker News 以约 1215 分、785 条评论居首，讨论集中于新模型的智能、性能与价格，兼具行业影响力与读者关注度，适合作为当日头条。
headline.reason_en: Model launches typically carry the broadest impact; this item topped Hacker News with about 1,215 points and 785 comments, with discussion centered on intelligence, performance and pricing, making it both high-impact and high-interest as the lead item.
